page.layout: One page, title page. Main title block centred at the top, with "id est," below it and a full-width italic paragraph of the subtitle beneath. A gathering signature at the lower right. Faint mirrored show-through above the title and in the lower half, not transcribed.

page.notes: Show-through, not transcribed: mirrored title line "AD CHRISTIANUM" above the main title, and faint text lines in the lower half from the reverse side. A faint curved outline to the right of "id est," may be show-through of a woodcut on the reverse; not a printed element here. Signature "C 4" is uncertain: the numeral may be a 4 or another sign, marked [?]. Long s is rendered as s throughout. "IESV" is normalised to IESU, since the V is a vowel. The title line "CHARACTE-RES" keeps its printed hyphen.
